name: refined
description: Refine.ink MCP for Grok Bot — upload papers, run proofreading reviews, and act on comments.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Refine.ink academic proofreading to Grok Bot via hosted MCP.
interface.longDescription: Packages Refine's hosted MCP endpoint (https://api.refine.ink/mcp) — the same server listed in the Claude Connectors Directory — plus a skill for uploading documents, running reviews, watching progress, and working through comments. OAuth by default.
defaultPrompt: List my recent Refine proofreading sessions.
Upload this manuscript to Refine and run a preview review.
